context: Mei and Aoi wait in line at a popular shop.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (かける/列/探す/おっしゃる/乗る) in natural home.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: すごい列だね。最後尾、探そう。
lines.en: What a line. Let's find the end.
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 並ぶのに、時間をかけそうね。
lines.en: It'll take time to queue up.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 店員さんが、一時間待ちとおっしゃってたよ。
lines.en: The staff said it's a one-hour wait.
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 電車に乗って、出直そうか?
lines.en: Shall we take the train and come back?
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: せっかく来たし、列に並ぼうよ。
lines.en: We came all this way, let's queue.
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 席を探すのも、大変そうね。
lines.en: Finding a seat looks hard too.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 店員さんが、奥が空くとおっしゃってた。
lines.en: The staff said the back will open up.
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 時間をかけても、食べたいね。
lines.en: Even spending time, I want to eat here.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
